document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
When the tracks climb a slope of jagged talus, the trail vanishes. 
You search for the remainder of the day but fail to reacquire it. 
Finally, you and Norman sit together in silence. Neither of you 
wants to admit that Sylvia is just as lost as Bernard. But you are 
out of options and must attempt to return to civilization.
